module.name: explain
module.description: A formula explained line by line and part by part: aligned rows with a note beside each row, labels under or over the parts named with \focus, and a legend of the symbols. Body = LaTeX rows, then the labels and the legend.
module.aiSpec:
EXPLAIN a formula — a multi-line derivation with a NOTE beside each line (why that step holds), LABELS under/over the parts of the formula (what each part is), and a LEGEND of the symbols. Use it instead of a table "formula | reason", \underbrace with a text label, or a "ここで … は …" line under a formula. Japanese never goes inside the math: notes, labels and legend items are Markdown text (math in them as \( … \)).
Body, section 1 = the formula rows, in LaTeX WITHOUT delimiters (as in an `aligned` environment): one row per line, or rows ended with `\\`. `&` marks where the rows line up (usually before `=`); without any `&` the rows line up at their first relation (= ≈ ≤ ≥ < > ≠ ≡ ⇔ ⇒ :=). A row may start with the relation (`&= …`). The NOTE of a row comes after `&&` on that row (Markdown). Section 2 (after `<!-- @ -->`) = one line per label or legend item: • `#name: text` — a LABEL for the part written `\focus{name}{…}` in the formula (the same name a narration cue points at: [[look: #name]]). Options between the name and the colon, in any order: `above` (default below), `2` / `3` (a farther level, for a label that would touch its neighbour's), `left` / `right` (align the label with the part's left / right end instead of its centre), `line` (a short line instead of a brace) or `plain` (nothing), `step=N` (the label appears at build step N), `color=#D55E00`. • any other line — a LEGEND item, e.g. `\(\bar d\): 差の標本平均` (each item is kept on one line where it fits; items flow side by side). A label takes no width in the formula — two labels below neighbouring parts can overlap: put one `above` or give it level `2`, and render the slide to check.
Parameters: • steps (select: none | rows | all | notes, default none) — build steps: `rows` = the 1st row is shown at once and each later row appears on the next step; `all` = every row appears on its own step; `notes` = the rows are shown, each NOTE appears on its own step (ask first, then give the reason). The script's [[step]] reveals. • from (number, default 1) — the first build step these use (when the slide has builds before the formula). • rows (text, default '') — a name prefix: rows become places `PREFIX1`, `PREFIX2`… for cues ([[look: #PREFIX2]] points at row 2 with its note). • notes (select: right | below, default right) — the notes beside the rows, or under each row (for a wide formula). • align (select: center | left, default center). • size (number, default 1) — scale of the whole block. • notecolor (color, default var(--muted-color)), labelcolor (color, default the text colour).
Example: <!-- @explain rows: t, steps: rows --> T &= \frac{\focus{d}{\bar x_1-\bar x_2}}{\focus{se}{\sqrt{\hat\sigma^2\left(\frac{1}{n_1}+\frac{1}{n_2}\right)}}} && 2 群の \(T\) &= \frac{53.0-50.0}{\sqrt{16\times 0.4}} && 値を入れる &\approx 1.19 && 自由度 8 の \(t\) 分布と比べる <!-- @ --> #d above: 標本平均の差 #se: 標本平均の差の標準誤差 \(\hat\sigma^2\): 合わせた不偏分散 <!-- @end -->
A cue at a labelled part (#d) rings the part with its brace and label; mark such a part with the default marker or `circle`, not `underline`. For a frame around the whole, put the module in @callout.

param.desc: The first build step used (when earlier builds come before the formula).

param.label: Row names

param.desc: Where the notes of the rows go.

param.label: Label colour
param.desc: Colour of the labels of the parts (blank = the text colour).
